scope: Source-built native SET20 strict592/open-only admission, GET21 result, GET103 actual current network. Separate open SET22 teardown subset documented in NativeTeardownSources.json.

artifact.wrapper: Preserves original code/data addresses; no Apple binary modification.

native_evidence.contract: Repeated RawGet with req.type21 at16, req.value32bit at20, length0 at24, null user pointer32. Value0 continues; nonzero passes to result mapper. Any ioctl error returns errno. Up to400polls; unresolved delay import not interpreted.
Inputs1..35 index table at0x1d3ef90d0; no guessed error-code mapping implemented.
Read140mappedbytes; first little-endian32bit entry is0, proving native result1 means successful return. Result0 pending is proven separately by poll body.

Original raw592/version1; mode16bit at4 default2; lower-auth16bit at6 set1 for open; upper-auth16bit at8 left0 in open branch; SSIDlen32bit12/data16/32bytes. ForceBSSID writes6bytes at48 and ORs0x20 into flag byte463. Remaining fields are zeroed absent extensions. Only this strict open subset accepted; unsupported nonzero key/privateMAC/flags/IE/extensions rejected. Root pointer is sp+0x218; saved REA assembly at1d3ebf2c8..2dc proves SSID root+0x10.

case103 bzeroes1164byte raw result, sets inlineIEcapacity1024 at0x8a, calls GetWrapper, passes result to __addScanResultToList. Current getter permits observed version0 and direct version1. Output uses existing proven result encoder with only actually associated peer metadata and its capturedIE/RSSI observation age.

backend_contract: SET20 resolver reads completed generation-bound observations. ExactSSID plus optional forcedBSSID must identify one openAP, otherwise ENOENT/EEXIST/EOPNOTSUPP. New typed target API supplies generation/index/BSSID/SSID/channel/band and rechecks generation/identity/freshness/security/policy/state under SAME transportLock as actual station_select; no cached-index race. Success means admission only; GET21 remains pending until genuine activation. Current103 requires real selected/open associated station and matching captured-peer metadata, completeIEs<=1024, actual RCPI; no scanned AP becomes current solely by query, no zero RSSI/truncation/updatedtimestamp. No IP/secure authorization success implied.
implementation_credit: Original board adapter implementation; no third-party association implementation copied. Existing MT6630 station parser/event source is reused without firmware ABI changes; Apple original code is inspected only as retained evidence.
limitations: Native secure/WEP/WPA/private-MAC/unknown-extension requests deliberately unsupported; key3/EAPOL/native supplicant owned by separate integration phase.
Open SET22 is a separate bounded teardown/admission subset; see NativeTeardownSources.json. Secure/key/data-inflight cancellation remains unsupported; no firmware completion invented.
GET103 preserves timestamp/RCPI of actual selected-peer observation, not a claimed new measurement. Missing/oversize/invalid metadata causes explicit failure.
No actual hardware SET20/open association/GET103 verified. Full SDK compilation remains parent gate.
codec_dependency_boundary: Pure SET20 decoder is isolated in A04BR3NativeAssociationCodec.h with explicit stdint/string/errno dependencies and own byte-only unicast validator. No SDIO/IOKit/test helper required. Actual standalone C11/C++14 -pedantic-errors -Werror ASan/UBSan compilation/execution, plus standalone production association/current headers, verified.
